name: Musicdisk
description: MOD, S3M, XM and IT player in the Dot look for the TrimUI Brick and Smart Pro: plays your modules from the SD card, with the pattern, real per-channel scopes and VU.
author: evolver79

changelog.v0.2.0: Runs on the TrimUI Smart Pro too, laid out for its wide screen. The Lights setting is gone: Musicdisk leaves the LEDs to NextUI. Tested on the Brick and the Smart Pro.
changelog.v0.1.0: First release: plays MOD, S3M, XM and IT modules from the SD card, with the pattern, real per-channel scopes and VU meters, an Info screen, shuffle, and the Brick's lights following the music. Drawn in Dot, the shared look of Kino, Tuner, Musicdisk and Speed.
